_schema.note: Tool lists observed directly in a live Claude session on 2026-07-26 -- the actual tool names exposed to the model, not a registry listing. Complete and untruncated, which is what makes this the calibration set: the registry returns tools:[] for connectors that are already connected, so these could not be harvested.
_schema.why_it_matters: engine/profile.py derives profiles from tool NAMES. Running the same derivation over these lists, where the ground truth is known, is the held-out test for the whole method.
correction_log: 2026-07-26 Phase 3: canva.ground_truth said 'no delete'. Parameter schemas disproved it. A held-out set with a wrong answer in it silently rewards the wrong derivation, so the correction is recorded here rather than only in docs/METHOD.md.
_schema.schema_note: Phase 3 added data/schemas/raw/*.jsonl: full JSONSchema for 178 of these 180 tools. That is a strictly stronger tier than VERIFIED, which is names only. See engine/schema.py.

gmail.ground_truth: No send tool. Drafting only -- create_draft/update_draft. Registry archetype claims side_effects=irreversible; reality is create.

google calendar.ground_truth: Exactly one tool. Semantic search only -- no date-range enumeration, no writes at all.

google drive.ground_truth: Reads and creates files; cannot delete or share.

vercel.ground_truth: Spends real money: buy_domain, buy_pro, buy_credits, buy_addon. Also deploys.

cloudflare developer platform.ground_truth: Cannot deploy a Worker. The workers_* family is read-only (list/get/get_code) even though d1_*, kv_*, r2_* all create and delete.

supabase.ground_truth: Full lifecycle including destructive project and branch operations.

canva.ground_truth: Creates and edits designs; exports. CORRECTED IN PHASE 3: this record previously read 'no delete', which was wrong. The parameter schemas show edit-design's operations include delete_element and merge-designs takes delete_pages ('CANNOT BE UNDONE'), and edit-design's own description calls commit IRREVERSIBLE. Canva's real side-effect class is irreversible. Tool names alone cannot show this -- the evidence is in an operations enum and in prose.

three.js 3d viewer.ground_truth: Two tools, renders in-chat, no external state.

tldraw.ground_truth: Two tools; exec runs arbitrary canvas JavaScript, so name-based inference cannot see its true reach. A deliberate failure case for the method.
